text: James reached out via the website chat. PeakFlow is a 40-person SaaS company. They are hitting rate limits on their current provider and are actively evaluating alternatives.
author: Dana Holt

text: Technical call with James and two engineers. They need a guaranteed 99.9% SLA and want SAML SSO as a hard requirement. Both are available on the enterprise tier.
author: Dana Holt

text: Sent enterprise proposal. James countered on price — asked for 15% discount on annual commit. Looping in sales leadership before responding.
author: Dana Holt
